name: @dinkster/e2e
description: Playwright smoke tests for the M0 vertical slice (needs a live ComfyUI backend).

scripts.test:e2e: playwright test --project=parallel-safe --workers=10 && playwright test --project=backend-serial --workers=1 && playwright test --project=performance --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:hosted: playwright test --config=playwright.hosted.config.ts --project=parallel-safe --workers=1 --shard=1/4 && playwright test --config=playwright.hosted.config.ts --project=parallel-safe --workers=1 --shard=2/4 && playwright test --config=playwright.hosted.config.ts --project=parallel-safe --workers=1 --shard=3/4 && playwright test --config=playwright.hosted.config.ts --project=parallel-safe --workers=1 --shard=4/4 && playwright test --config=playwright.hosted.config.ts --project=backend-serial --workers=1 --shard=1/2 && playwright test --config=playwright.hosted.config.ts --project=backend-serial --workers=1 --shard=2/2 && playwright test --config=playwright.hosted.config.ts --project=performance --workers=1
